area.comingSoon: Hamushanqa. Kay pata kunanqa mit'alla kachkan.

wellbeing.roughHelp: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
wellbeing.locksHelp: Huk ruwanata huk simanapaq, iskay simanapaq, huk killapaq utaq wiñaypaq wisq'ayta atinki. Llaki butun, kutimuq yanapay, hark'asqa waqyaykuna hinaspa willañiqikunata pichayqa manan hayk'aqpas wisq'asqachu.

community.noPhone: Masiykunapura willaykunapiqa manan hayk'aqpas telefunu yupaykuna rikhurinchu.

support.resourcesNote: Legal aid, treatment and transit. This directory does not cover food or housing.
support.meetingsTitle: Chunka iskayniyuq thatkiy hinaspa allinyay tantanakuykuna

safety.relapseDraft: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.safeContactsHelp: Sponsor-niykita utaq hark'asqa masikitaykita huk llamiyllapi hap'iy.
safety.vaultHelp: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.wipeHelp: Kayqa chiqapta willayñiykikunata pichan, mana kutinachu.

reentry.tipsAnonymous: Yuyaychakuykunaqa sutinnaykinmi. Telefunu yupaykunaqa manan hayk'aqpas rikhurinchu.
reentry.crisisStep: Kay yupaykunata kunan waqaychay. Chaymantapas "Need help now"-ta ñit'iyta atinki tukuy pantallap hawanpi.
reentry.resourceOnly: Qullqikunamanta pusaqlla — Groundwork kayta mana qunchu, pipaswan mana kuskachu.

steps.step7: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
steps.step8: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
steps.step9: Kacharikuq qillqakunata hinaspa tukuy punchawkunata qhaway
steps.step10: Ñawpaq check-in punchawta hinaspa kamachiykunata takyachiy
steps.step13: Telefonuta, email-ta hinaspa yanqalla internet-ta hap'iy
steps.step14: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
steps.step17: Check your fines, fees and restitution
steps.step18: Manijay licencian imanalla kachkan chayta qhaway
steps.step19: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
steps.step27: Iskay kutiq atipanakuy qukuq patronkunaman mañakuy
steps.step29: Banku cuentata kichay hinaspa gastuta wakichiy
steps.step31: Aylluykiwan tinkunakuy, wawakunapaq yanapayta allichay sichus tiyan
steps.step33: Huk karu umalliqta churay hinaspa 90 punchawniykikunata raymichay

work.paroleNote: Check your parole or probation conditions with your officer before applying.

journey.portfolioPrivate: Qallariymanta pakasqa. Aknay sichus akllanki chaylla.

venue.placeholder: Mit'alla pata — uqi caxa cuartu. Pata chiqap qhawachikuykuna manaqusachu; kayqa manan chiqap patachu.

readAloud.title: Sinchita ñawinchay
readAloud.help: Sinchita ñawinchayqa qillqata ñawinchananpaq aparatuykip rimayninwan llamk'achkan.

phase3.headline: Uma qillqa
phase3.interviewHelp: Kutichiykunata maliy. Yachachiqniyki puntota hinaspa huk yuyaychakuyta qun.
phase3.gigsHelp: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.paidNote: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.geoHelp: Wakin runakuna llaqtaykillata rikunkun. Chiqap patanqa manan hayk'aqpas aknasqachu.
phase3.rideHelp: Carrota mañakuy. Telefunu yupaykunaqa manan hayk'aqpas rikhurinchu. Runakunap tantanakusqanpi tinkunakuychis.
phase3.caption: Siyap qillqan
phase3.merchHelp: Codigulla rikuchikuykuna. Hawanpiqa manan imapas ninchu iman ninanta, punchawkunapas mana qillqasqachu.
phase3.archiveHelp: Qanpaq cartata mich'ay. Hatun punchawpi kichakunqa.
phase3.matchHelp: Agent-niykiqa ñawpaqta huk agentkunawan riman. Citasqa kunan wisq'asqan kachkan. Rikunkiman imanas, riqsichiyta mañakunkiman hinaspa musuqmanta kutichinkiman.
phase3.datingOff: Citasqa wisq'asqan kachkan chayamanta aslla punchawkunap kamachiyninqa churakunankama.
phase3.carpoolHelp: Ñawpaqta kaypi qhaway. Munasqaykiman, llaqta kamallapi: qhaway pita tantanakuykiman rin hinaspa app willaykunawan tinkunakuy. Manan telefonuchu, manan chiqap patachu.
phase3.groupsHelp: Allinyay, kutiy yanapay, iñiy hinaspa ayllu tantanakuykuna llaqtaman hinaspa tantanakuy oraman. Qhawachina willaykuna — manan chiqap qillqachu.
phase3.rideFallbackHelp: Rikhurinlla sichus tablapiqa pipas tantanakuykiman rinchu. App-pi qhawapayasqa mañakuyta willan — llaqta kamallapi, mana telefonuyuq.
phase3.noCarpoolMatch: Kay tantanakuytaq manan carpool tiyanchu, chayrayku Carrota munani yanapayhina rikhurin.
phase3.familyRideHelp: Chaskisqa manijaykuna sapalla. Avisokuna hukmanta hukmanta 2 minutu suyaywan rinku; ñawpaqta qan takyachinki hamuqmanta.
phase3.housingHelp: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.musicHelp: Qhawachina takikunalla. Manan streaming cuentakunachu. Tuqyachiqqa akademia hinaspa curso modulukunapi wisq'asqa kachkan.
phase3.musicOffAcademy: Musiqaqa wisq'asqan kachkan curso modulupi kachkaptiykiqa.
phase3.shareWho: Kunan: qanlla. Link-ta ruwaspaqa linkniyuq tukuy ñawinchayta atinman.
